reports.note.arrived: Arrived counts every patient who checked in today, whether they are still waiting, with the doctor, or already done.
reports.note.booked: Booked counts every serial issued for a session in this range, whatever became of it.
reports.note.collected_ratio: Commission collected is apportioned by the invoice's paid ratio: a half-paid bill has half its commission earned.
reports.note.collection: Collection is settled payments minus processed refunds, counted on the clinic's local day.
reports.note.commission_frozen: Commission reads the share frozen on the invoice at issue, never the current rule, so an old month never changes.
reports.note.consult: Consultation time is called to completed. Samples under 30 seconds or over 30 minutes are excluded, exactly as the live queue's estimate does.
reports.note.diagnosis_unit: A diagnosis is counted once per visit, even if it appears as both provisional and final.
reports.note.distinct_patients: Patients are counted once each, however many visits they made in the range.
reports.note.doctor_overlap: A patient seen by two doctors appears under both, so the per-doctor rows add up to more than the clinic total.
reports.note.follow_up: Compliance is measured only on follow-ups whose date has already passed; one advised for next month has not been missed yet.
reports.note.follow_up_draft: The draft appointment the system creates automatically does not count as booked — only a real booking does.
reports.note.generic_only: The share of prescription lines written by molecule with no brand named.
reports.note.issued_only: Only issued prescriptions are counted. Drafts, voided sheets and superseded versions of an amended prescription are left out.
reports.note.live: Live counts are for today only and change as the desk works.
reports.note.local_time: Days and hours are the clinic's own local time, not UTC.
reports.note.new_patient: A patient is new when their first ever visit to this clinic falls inside the range — not their first visit to this doctor.
reports.note.no_show: A no-show is a serial whose final status is no-show, whether marked automatically or by the desk. A reinstated serial is not counted.
reports.note.no_show_rate: The no-show rate excludes cancelled and postponed serials: they never became an attendance opportunity.
reports.note.overrun: Overrun is the actual end against the planned end, for closed sessions only. A session ending within 15 minutes of plan is not counted as an overrun.
reports.note.p90: Nine patients in ten waited less than this. Staff for this number, not for the average.
reports.note.patient_trend: The trend counts a patient once on each day they were seen, so its days add up to more than the distinct total above.
reports.note.peak_metric: Arrivals is the staffing signal: when patients are physically at the desk, not when they booked.
reports.note.refund_day: A refund reduces the day it was processed, so it can lower a month whose payment was taken earlier.
reports.note.snapshot: Drug names are the snapshot written on the prescription, so an old report keeps the names the patient was given.
reports.note.source: Source is the serial's own channel: online and kiosk are patient self-service; counter, walk-in and offline are the desk.
reports.note.today: Every tile on this row is today in the clinic's timezone.
reports.note.transfer: A serial transferred to another doctor appears as cancelled under the first doctor and live under the second.
reports.note.uncoded: A diagnosis written without an ICD-10 code is grouped by its text, so it is still counted.
reports.note.wait: Wait is check-in to called. A patient who never arrived contributes nothing rather than a zero.
reports.note.weekday_occurrences: Per-occurrence divides a weekday's total by how many times that weekday falls inside the range.

saas.handbook.billing-and-plans.note: An unpaid invoice never deletes anything. Your data stays exactly where it is until you settle it.
saas.handbook.billing-and-plans.para.1: Your plan decides how many branches, doctors, monthly appointments and SMS credits you get. You can see how much of each you have used at any time.
saas.handbook.billing-and-plans.step.1: Open Subscription in the panel to see your plan and your usage this month.
saas.handbook.billing-and-plans.step.2: An invoice is issued at the start of every billing period and is payable within seven days.
saas.handbook.billing-and-plans.step.3: If it stays unpaid you will get three reminders, then the account is suspended on the tenth day.
saas.handbook.billing-and-plans.step.4: Paying reactivates the account immediately — nothing has to be restored.

saas.handbook.custom-domain.note: Your clinic's default address keeps working after you add a custom domain, so nothing breaks while DNS spreads.
saas.handbook.custom-domain.para.1: You can serve your booking site and live queue from your own hostname, for example queue.yourhospital.com, once you have proved that you own it.
saas.handbook.custom-domain.step.1: Add the hostname on the Domains screen in the panel.
saas.handbook.custom-domain.step.2: Create the TXT record we show you at your DNS provider.
saas.handbook.custom-domain.step.3: For a subdomain add a CNAME to our platform host; for a bare domain add an A record instead.
saas.handbook.custom-domain.step.4: Press Verify. Once it checks out the address starts serving your clinic within a minute.

saas.handbook.getting-started.para.1: A new clinic is ready to take bookings within a few minutes. You need a branch, at least one doctor and one weekly schedule.
saas.handbook.getting-started.step.1: Sign up and choose a plan; your free trial starts immediately.
saas.handbook.getting-started.step.2: Add your branch details, logo and contact number.

saas.handbook.offline-reception.note: Only the reception desk works offline. Prescriptions and refunds always need a connection.
saas.handbook.offline-reception.para.1: The reception desk keeps issuing serials when the internet drops. It leases a block of numbers in advance, so two desks can never hand out the same number.
saas.handbook.offline-reception.step.1: Register each desk tablet once, while you are online.
saas.handbook.offline-reception.step.2: During an outage keep issuing serials as usual — the desk shows an OFFLINE indicator.

saas.handbook.prescriptions.note: An issued prescription can never be edited. An amendment creates a new version and the original stays retrievable forever.
saas.handbook.prescriptions.para.1: The prescription writer is built for speed: shorthand, favourites and one-click templates, with safety checks running against the molecule rather than the brand.
saas.handbook.prescriptions.step.1: Open the patient from the queue and record vitals if you need them.
saas.handbook.prescriptions.step.2: Type drugs in shorthand — the writer expands dose, timing and duration.
saas.handbook.prescriptions.step.3: Review the interaction, allergy and dose alerts before you issue.
saas.handbook.prescriptions.step.4: Issue and print, or send it by SMS or WhatsApp with a verifiable link.

super.settings.title: Platform settings
super.tenants.cancel_body: Cancelling ends the subscription of :name. No data is deleted.
super.tenants.cancel_immediately_help: Leave this off to let the clinic run until the end of the period it has already paid for.
super.tenants.create_intro: Onboard a clinic on its behalf. This runs the same provisioning as public sign-up: a schema, roles, the first branch and the owner’s admin login.
super.tenants.delete.acknowledge: I understand this drops the clinic’s schema and every record in it. Only the export archive survives.
super.tenants.delete.blocked_invoices: Deletion is refused while :count invoice(s) remain unsettled. Record the payment or void them on the Billing tab first.
super.tenants.delete.dialog_body: The schema :schema will be dropped and cannot be recovered from this console. The hostnames are released, the subscription is cancelled and the row is kept only as a deleted record.
super.tenants.delete.error.export_requir: A completed data export from the last 24 hours is required before the schema can be dropped. Run step one and wait for it to finish.
super.tenants.delete.error.slug_mismatch: Type the clinic’s address exactly as shown.
super.tenants.delete.error.unsettled: This clinic has :count unsettled invoice(s). Settle or void them before deleting.
super.tenants.delete.export_missing: No export in the last :hours hours
super.tenants.delete.flash.export_queued: Data export queued. When it shows as completed above, step two opens.
super.tenants.delete.intro: Two steps, on purpose. A full export must exist before the schema is dropped, and unsettled invoices block it altogether. Nothing here can be undone.
super.tenants.delete.step1_help: JSON and CSV of every table plus the uploads, kept for 30 days. Download it from the list above before step two.
super.tenants.delete.step2_help: Type the clinic’s address to confirm. Opens only once a fresh export has completed.
super.tenants.delete.title: Delete this clinic
super.tenants.domains_subdomain_hint: The platform address :host follows the clinic’s slug — change it from the Edit screen. Add the clinic’s own hostname here.
super.tenants.empty_deleted: No deleted clinic matches this search.
super.tenants.flash.created: :clinic is provisioned and ready. Hand the owner their credential from the dialog.
super.tenants.flash.deleted: :clinic deleted. Schema :schema dropped; the export archive is kept at :export.
super.tenants.flash.reactivate_refused: :clinic was not reactivated: unpaid invoices are outstanding. Tick “reactivate even with unpaid invoices” to override.
super.tenants.flash.renamed: Address changed from :old to :new. Staff must sign in again on the new address.
super.tenants.form.admin_email_help: Leave blank to use the owner’s e-mail.
super.tenants.form.admin_name_help: Leave blank to use the owner’s name.
super.tenants.form.credential_link_help: E-mailed to the user on the clinic’s own address and shown to you once, valid for one hour.
super.tenants.form.credential_password_h: Shown to you once. The user must change it at first sign-in.
super.tenants.form.custom_domain_help: For example booking.hospital.com. It starts unverified; the TXT proof appears on the Domains tab.
super.tenants.form.demo_help: Two doctors, two weeks of schedules and thirty patients — for a clinic that wants to click around before entering its own.
super.tenants.form.logo_help: PNG, JPG, WebP or SVG, up to 2 MB. Shown on the public booking site.
super.tenants.form.name: Clinic name
super.tenants.form.name_bn_help: Shown on the Bangla booking site and printed slips.
super.tenants.form.notes_help: Internal, for the platform team only — the clinic never sees this.
super.tenants.form.password_required: Type a password, or choose the set-password link instead.
super.tenants.form.plan_trial: This plan gives :days days of trial by default.
super.tenants.form.section.admin_help: The hospital-admin account the owner signs in with.
super.tenants.form.section.domain_help: Optional. The platform subdomain is created either way.
super.tenants.form.section.owner_help: The primary contact for billing and dunning.
super.tenants.form.slug_help: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, 2–63 characters. Becomes the clinic’s subdomain.
super.tenants.form.slug_immutable: The address :host is fixed here. To move the clinic to a new subdomain use “Change subdomain” below — it is a separate, confirmed and audited step.
super.tenants.form.slug_invalid: Only lowercase letters, digits and hyphens; it must start and end with a letter or digit.
super.tenants.form.slug_reserved: This address is reserved by the platform.
super.tenants.form.trial_days_help: Leave blank for the plan’s default (:days). 0 starts the clinic on a paid period at once.
super.tenants.impersonate_help: You sign in to the clinic’s own panel as one of its staff. Every action is audited under your name.
super.tenants.mail.set_password.body: Hello :name, an account has been prepared for you at :clinic. Use the link below to set your password within :minutes minutes; it works once. If you were not expecting this, ignore this message.
super.tenants.mail.set_password.subject: Set your password for :clinic
super.tenants.no_subscription: This clinic has no live subscription.
super.tenants.plan_body: Move :name from :from to :to (:cycle)? Entitlements change now; the new price applies from the next billing period. Nothing is prorated.
super.tenants.reactivate_arrears: :count invoice(s) are unpaid. Reactivating without settling them needs the override below.
super.tenants.reactivate_body: Staff at :name can sign in again and the public booking pages answer from the next request. The subscription returns to active.
super.tenants.reason_help: This is what support and the audit log will show.
super.tenants.rename.body: The current address :host stops answering the moment this is saved. Every staff session on it is signed out, and any SMS or printed link carrying the old address stops working unless a verified custom domain is the primary. The old address becomes free for another clinic to claim.
super.tenants.rename.confirm_help: Type the current address :slug to confirm.
super.tenants.rename.confirm_mismatch: Type the current address exactly as shown.
super.tenants.rename.same_slug: That is already the clinic’s address.
super.tenants.rename.title: Change this clinic’s subdomain
super.tenants.reveal.must_change: The user is asked to choose their own password at first sign-in.
super.tenants.reveal.once: This is shown once. Closing this dialog discards it — copy it now.

super.tenants.staff.deactivate_body: :name is signed out of every device at once, their remembered logins are revoked, and they cannot sign in until reactivated.
super.tenants.staff.empty: This clinic has no staff accounts.
super.tenants.staff.error.email_taken: An account with the e-mail :email already exists in this clinic.
super.tenants.staff.error.not_found: No such staff account in this clinic.
super.tenants.staff.flash.created: Account for :name created. Hand over the credential from the dialog.
super.tenants.staff.flash.deactivated: :name has been deactivated and signed out everywhere.
super.tenants.staff.flash.reset: Credential for :name issued. It is shown once in the dialog.
super.tenants.staff.form.name: Name
super.tenants.staff.last_admin_warning: This is the clinic’s last active hospital admin. Nobody at the clinic will be able to manage staff until another admin exists.
super.tenants.staff.reset_mode_link_help: E-mailed and shown to you once. Nothing changes until they follow it.
super.tenants.staff.reset_mode_password_: Shown to you once. Every existing session of this account is signed out.
super.tenants.staff.subtitle: :count account(s), read from the clinic’s own schema.
super.tenants.staff.title: Staff
super.tenants.suspend_body: Staff at :name will not be able to sign in and the public booking pages stop answering. Nothing is deleted.

super.usage.board_help: Sorted by share of the plan cap; :percent% and above counts as near the limit.
super.usage.board_uncapped: No plan caps this metric; clinics are listed by volume.
